prompt_text: Who is the best orthodontist in Atlanta for braces or Invisalign?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t one objectively “best” orthodontist for everyone—case complexity, location, budget, and how much you value Invisalign versus braces all matter. A good shortlist to compare:

- **West Paces Ferry Orthodontics** — A strong option if you’re especially interested in Invisalign; the practice says its orthodontists are board-certified and it is a Diamond Plus Invisalign provider. It also offers braces. [Website](https://www.westpacesferryortho.com/)
- **Harris Orthodontics** — Dr. Peyton Harris is board-certified and offers both braces and Invisalign; the office is at 800 Marietta St NW. [Website](https://harrisorthodonticsatl.com/)
- **Buckhead Orthodontics** — Offers traditional braces and clear aligners, with a strong reported review rating. [Practice listing](https://nationalorthodonticregistry.com/georgia/atlanta-ga/orthodontists/buckhead-orthodontics-atlanta-ga)
- **Atlanta Orthodontic Specialists** — Offers braces and Invisalign at multiple Atlanta-area locations. [Practice listing](https://nationalorthodonticregistry.com/georgia/atlanta-ga/orthodontists/atlanta-orthodontic-specialists-atlanta-ga)

**My practical pick:** Start with West Paces Ferry if Invisalign is your priority; otherwise, compare it with a board-certified orthodontist near you who offers both options. Book two or three consultations and ask each orthodontist to explain the treatment plan, expected duration, total cost, and what happens if treatment needs adjustment. Check credentials and recent reviews independently, since ratings and provider distinctions can change.
